title: 第9章 材料已齐开始逆天改命第10章 逆天改命恐怖天劫降临
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
世间九大禁地之一其主。
曾掀起过无边杀劫。
还有超恐怖杀阵相助。
轮回主不信镇压不了陈长生！
轰——
超恐怖杀阵最强威能展开，不可想象的至强阵纹跳动。
这是连天帝强者都可轰杀掉的至强阵纹！
轮回主更是将一身力量全面爆发出来。
打出它最恐怖的攻击！
刹那间——
天穹崩塌，时空长河断流，比之末日还恐怖的场景出现。
这种情况下，别说什么新晋天帝了。
就算是一些老牌天帝。
也注定抵挡不住，将会被镇压！
九头狮心都提到了嗓子眼上。
紧张害怕至极。
它这辈子都没有见过这么恐怖的力量！
毫不夸张的说。
这力量哪怕只是一缕落到它身上，也足以杀它千百遍！
咚——

天地巨震，陈长生还是仅向前迈了一步。
所有向他轰击过来的力量。
顷刻间，全都消散彻底！
轮回主耗尽心血布下的超恐怖大杀阵。
更是瞬间炸开，全面崩碎！
轮回主被无形力量禁锢，定在当场！
“什么！”
轮回主满脸惊悚，魂都快被吓散了。
这怎么可能！
一步踏出，超恐怖大阵崩碎，它被禁锢！
陈长生到底有多强？！
它不敢想象！
“我…！
！”
九头狮看的怀疑狮生！
天呐！
超恐怖可怕的轮回主。
掀起无边杀劫，都没有强者能奈何得了。
结果，轮回主就这样被一步镇压了？！
尤其这里还是轮回主的老巢。

轮回主还开启了超恐怖大阵！
content_en:
The owner of one of the nine forbidden places in the world.
It has caused endless carnage.
There is also a super terrifying killing array to help.
The Lord of Samsara does not believe that he cannot suppress Chen Changsheng!
Boom——
The most powerful power of the ultra-terrible killing array unfolds, and the unimaginable and powerful array beats.
This is the most powerful formation pattern that can kill even the powerful Emperor of Heaven!
The Lord of Samsara exploded with all his strength.
Launch its most terrifying attack!
In an instant——
The sky collapsed, the long river of time and space ceased to flow, and a scene more terrifying than the apocalypse appeared.
In this case, let alone the new emperor.
Even some veteran emperors.
It is destined to be unable to resist and will be suppressed!
The nine-headed lion's heart was in his throat.
Extremely nervous and scared.
It has never seen such terrifying power in its life!
Quite literally.
Even if just a ray of this power falls on it, it is enough to kill it thousands of times!
Boom——
The heaven and earth shook violently, but Chen Changsheng still only took one step forward.
All the forces bombarding him.
In an instant, everything dissipated completely!
The Lord of Samsara spent all his efforts to lay out a super terrifying killing array.
It exploded instantly and completely shattered!
The Lord of Samsara was imprisoned by an invisible force and was fixed on the spot!
"What!"
The reincarnation master's face was full of horror, and his soul was almost scared away.
How is this possible!
With one step forward, the super terrifying formation collapsed and it was imprisoned!
How strong is Chen Changsheng? !
It can't be imagined!
"I...!
! "
The nine-headed lion looked suspicious of Shisheng!
Oh my God!
The super scary and terrifying Lord of Reincarnation.
It caused boundless carnage, and no strong person could do anything about it.
As a result, the Lord of Samsara was suppressed in one step? !
Especially since this is the home of the Lord of Reincarnation.
The Lord of Reincarnation also opened a super terrifying formation!
